description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting the importance of this position in ensuring exceptional patient care and operational excellence.As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, maintaining high standards of care, and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact within a compassionate and resident-focused setting. We are looking for a candidate who is ready to contribute their expertise and drive positive outcomes.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, such as Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing.
Demonstrated experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment.
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and support a compassionate nursing team within a dynamic environment.As the ADON, you will collaborate closely with the Director of Nursing to oversee daily operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain the highest standards of clinical excellence. Your responsibilities will include supervising nursing staff, participating in care planning, and fostering a positive and productive work atmosphere.This full-time position offers an attractive annual salary range of $75,000 to $85,000. If you are a passionate RN with leadership aspirations and a commitment to quality care, we encourage you to apply and become a key part of our team.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a long-term care or skilled nursing setting
Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 to $85,000, based on experience.
